source_attribution.limit: Repository line attribution is source evidence; the user approval separately establishes release review and curatorship. It does not establish that this person composed every word.

license_evidence_limit: The observed CC-BY-4.0 source notice and attribution are retained; no legal certification or third-party provenance audit is asserted.
